destination.name: Gold Coast Hinterland
destination.tagline: Rainforest waterfalls and mountain lookouts just behind the Gold Coast
destination.description: The Gold Coast Hinterland is the rural area west of the Gold Coast, made up of rainforest-covered mountain ranges, most of it national park. Walking tracks lead to waterfalls such as Coomera Falls and Morans Falls in Lamington National Park. Freeman's Lookout and Rosin's Lookout face the Numinbah Valley, and the 54 km Gold Coast Hinterland Great Walk links Lamington and Springbrook over three days.
whyVisit: Take in lookouts over the coast
Hike the Great Walk through rainforest

goodToKnow.title: A car is far easier
goodToKnow.detail: Public transport west of the M1 is very sparse, so a car is far easier.

goodToKnow.title: Pages Pinnacle needs experience
goodToKnow.detail: The Pages Pinnacle walk is about 6 km return and suits experienced hikers.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the cooler, drier months, which suit waterfall walks and lookouts.
